pkgmetadata.longdescription: Warp is a GPU-accelerated terminal and agentic development environment written in Rust. This package builds the warp-oss binary, the open-source channel of the upstream repository: unlike the vendor's own builds it has telemetry, crash reporting and the autoupdater compiled out. Installed as warp-terminal-oss so it can coexist with a vendor-supplied Warp.
